accepted_execution_head: external independently signed exact current live HEAD; no self-referential commit binding
archive_transfer: existing accepted artifacts only; whole-byte rematerialization and exact archive/series/header verification on execution host before signing; no broker or re-acquisition
crash_rule: one durable invocation reservation; all restarts rejected; forensic checkpoint inspection only; no scientific replay
host_binding: signed exact hostname, device id, filesystem type and independent durability evidence digest; observed matches required before bytes or reservation
